title: Unit – 1 : Session – 8 : SLO – 2 | Implement Threading
sections: 1) Hello thread: class Hello extends Thread { public void run(){ System.out.println("Hello"); } }  new Hello().start(); — or new Thread(() -> System.out.println("Hello")).start();

2) Even/odd threads: Thread even = new Thread(() -> { for(int i=2;i<=10;i+=2) System.out.println("Even "+i); });  Thread odd = new Thread(() -> { for(int i=1;i<=10;i+=2) System.out.println("Odd "+i); });  even.start(); odd.start(); — outputs interleave nondeterministically.

3) sleep and join: Thread t = new Thread(() -> { try { Thread.sleep(500); } catch(InterruptedException e){} System.out.println("child done"); });  t.start(); t.join(); // main waits until t finishes  System.out.println("main done"); — sleep(ms) pauses the current thread; join() makes the caller wait for the other thread's termination, so 'main done' always prints after 'child done'.
